hooks.prompt:
BEFORE exiting plan mode, you MUST complete a full plan review loop:

1. Spawn 2 review agents IN PARALLEL on the ENTIRE plan file:
   - Agent A (Industry Design Checker): CLAUDE.md conventions
   - Agent B (Completeness + Quality): edge cases, error handling, test plan
2. Fix ALL findings. Re-run until zero findings.
3. Print compliance report (MEASURED, not guessed).
4. Run: touch $TMPDIR/claude_plan_review_done
5. Then proceed with ExitPlanMode.

If you have already completed the review loop and created the marker file, ALLOW the ExitPlanMode call.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking review + test gates before task completion...

hooks.prompt: Check if this Bash command is: (1) a git push to main — if it pushes directly to main (e.g. 'git push origin main', or 'git push' while on main branch), BLOCK it with 'No direct pushes to main — all changes must go via PRs'. (2) a git commit — verify the FULL command text contains 'APP-{N}: ' where N is a number (Linear issue reference) — note the commit message may span multiple lines in a heredoc. (3) creates a new branch (git checkout -b, git branch <name>, git switch -c) — verify the branch name matches 'feat/app-{N}-*' pattern. If the command is not related to git push/commit/branch creation, ALLOW it. If it violates a convention, BLOCK it with an explanation. Command: $ARGUMENTS

hooks.command: pr=$(gh pr view --json number -q .number 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pr" ] && gh pr comment "$pr" --body "@gemini review" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

hooks.statusMessage: Requesting Gemini review on PR (via make push)...

hooks.prompt:
A push just completed via make push. You MUST now poll for Gemini review and fix all findings:

1. Record PUSH_TIME=$(date -u -v-30S +%%Y-%%m-%%dT%%H:%%M:%%SZ) (30s clock-skew buffer)
2. Wait for Gemini review: poll every 30s until gemini-code-assist[bot] review appears
3. Fetch ALL Gemini line-level comments created after PUSH_TIME
4. Fix ALL high, medium, and low severity findings
5. If fixes made: run spotlessApply, commit, run all 3 test suites, push again (which triggers another Gemini round)
6. Loop until Gemini has zero actionable comments

Do NOT skip this. Do NOT say 'I already pushed'. Do NOT move on without polling Gemini. This is MANDATORY after every push.
hooks.statusMessage: Enforcing Gemini review poll after push...

[ "$EXIT_CODE" -eq 0 ] && jq -nc '{decision:"block", reason:"A git commit just completed. You MUST now run ALL three test suites before pushing or doing anything else:

  1. ./gradlew test
  2. ./gradlew :integration-tests:test
  3. ./gradlew e2e

Do NOT skip any suite. Do NOT claim they were already run. Execute each command and report results."}' || exit 0
